name: Software freight brokerage
title: Digital freight brokerage after Convoy: is the market back?
question: Is digital freight brokerage viable again after Convoy shut down?
answer: Convoy automated truckload brokerage, raised hundreds of millions of dollars, and shut down in late 2023 during a long freight recession; Flexport bought its assets. The killer was the rate cycle, not the software. The board tracks the BLS producer price index for long-distance truckload freight; it rose about 18% between March and September 2026.
verdict_reason: Rates are recovering; the call on whether the recovery holds resolves from BLS data in 2027.

constraint.name: The truckload rate cycle
constraint.detail: Brokers earn the spread between shipper and carrier rates; in a long freight recession the spread and volume both collapse.

crossing.text: Sustained recovery in truckload rates (resolves from BLS data).

metric.label: Producer price index: long-distance general freight trucking, truckload (BLS, via FRED)
